What happens next

  1. Pay securely when checkout is open.
  2. We prepare your first complete illustrated proof within 7 calendar days of payment.
  3. You check every page and approve it.
  4. Our team reviews it and releases it to print.
  5. Prodigi prints and delivers your book.

Estimated UK delivery: 7–12 working days after final proof approval. Delays or corrections can add time.
